nodes.label: Subtitle Eraser Page
nodes.rationale: One-button burned-in caption removal: finds captions automatically, AI-reconstructs the background (no blur, no black box), shows a before/after comparison. Calls /api/qc/videos, /api/qc/remove-subs (method=erase), /api/job, /api/upload; progress parser tracks scan -> AI chunk inpainting -> encode phases and detects the ProPainter engine vs a classic-inpaint blur fallback.

nodes.label: ProPainter AI Subtitle Erase Engine
nodes.rationale: AI video inpainting that auto-detects burned-in captions and rebuilds the true background behind every letter, motion-matched frame by frame, in chunks (scan -> chunk inpaint -> encode). Falls back to classic inpaint/blur if the AI engine is unavailable. The 'proven' server pipeline carries a width-16 ProPainter fix and corruption retry; originals are always backed up and restorable.
